lines: Yeh log, patthar ke dil hain jin ke
Numaish-e-rang mein hain doobe
couplets.en: These people with hearts of stone are lost in a show of color.

lines: Yeh kaghazi phool jaise chehre
Mazaq udate hain aadmi ka
couplets.en: These faces, like paper flowers, make a mockery of being human.

lines: Inhein koi kaash yeh bata de
Maqaam ooncha hai saadgi ka
couplets.en: If only someone would tell them how much dignity there is in simplicity.

lines: Inhein bhala zakhm ki khabar kya
Ke teer chalte hue na dekha
couplets.en: What would they know of the wound, having never seen the arrow fly?

lines: Udaas aankhon mein aarzuon
Ka khoon jalte hue na dekha
couplets.en: They have never seen the blood of longing burn in sorrowful eyes.

lines: Andhera chhaya hai in ke aage
Haseen ghaflat ki roshni ka
couplets.en: The glow of their lovely oblivion casts a darkness before them.

lines: Yeh kaghazi phool jaise chehre
Mazaq udate hain aadmi ka
couplets.en: These faces, like paper flowers, make a mockery of being human.

lines: Yeh sehn-e-gulshan mein jab gaye hain
Bahaar hi loot le gaye hain
couplets.en: When they entered the garden, they made off with spring itself.

lines: Jahaan gaye hain, yeh do dilon ka
Qaraar hi loot le gaye hain
couplets.en: Wherever they went, they robbed two hearts of their peace.

lines: Ke dil dukhana hai in ka shewa
Inhein hai ehsaas kab kisi ka
couplets.en: They make a habit of hurting hearts, with little thought for anyone.

lines: Yeh kaghazi phool jaise chehre
Mazaq udate hain aadmi ka
couplets.en: These faces, like paper flowers, make a mockery of being human.

lines: Main jhoot ki jagmagati mehfil
Mein aaj sach bolne laga hoon
couplets.en: Today I have begun to speak the truth in this glittering company of lies.

lines: Main ho ke majboor apne geeton
Mein zehr phir gholne laga hoon
couplets.en: With little choice left, I have begun to stir poison into my songs again.

lines: Yeh zehr shaayad uda de nasha
Ghuroor mein doobi zindagi ka
couplets.en: Perhaps this poison will sober a life drunk on pride.
